<p class="page-intro">A small set of active projects that show how I move from national policy questions to spatial, farm-level and implementation evidence.</p>

<div class="editorial-list">

<div class="editorial-item">
<div class="editorial-kicker">Spatial foresight · Ireland</div>
<div>
<h3><a href="goblin-spatial/">GOBLIN-Spatial</a></h3>
<p>Where nationally coherent agricultural transitions fall across Ireland, and whether future land-use requirements can fit within the resulting transition space.</p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="editorial-item">
<div class="editorial-kicker">Bioenergy · United States</div>
<div>
<h3><a href="bioland-us/">BioLand-US</a></h3>
<p>How compatible land and voluntary contracts constrain prospective U.S. perennial-biomass mobilisation.</p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="editorial-item">
<div class="editorial-kicker">Econometrics · United States</div>
<div>
<h3><a href="e-seat/">E-SEAT</a></h3>
<p>How much Corn Belt specialisation would reverse under a weaker ethanol-demand signal, and how much reflects structural persistence.</p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="editorial-item">
<div class="editorial-kicker">Farm-level modelling · Ireland</div>
<div>
<h3><a href="ift-biosim/">IFT-BioSim</a></h3>
<p>A farm-level framework for studying heterogeneous opportunity costs, participation and the distribution of transition costs.</p>
